About us

Who we are

A North Carolina specialty contractor built on field experience, trust, and quality workmanship.

J&A Tradesmen Corp. is a North Carolina-based specialty contractor providing mechanical insulation services and skilled trade labor support for commercial and industrial construction projects.

With more than 10 years of field experience, our team has built a strong reputation across the Triangle and statewide for delivering quality insulation systems on schedule, within budget, and in full compliance with project specifications and OSHA standards.

We have successfully supported projects at RDU Airport, NC State University, Wake Technical Community College, and the NIH Building in Morrisville — working alongside some of the most respected general contractors and mechanical contractors in North Carolina.

"We understand that customer satisfaction assures longevity in this industry. We strive to provide services that meet and exceed the expectations of owners, engineers, general contractors, and the contractors we work for."

Why Insulate?

The benefits of mechanical insulation

Properly installed insulation delivers measurable benefits across energy, safety, process control, and the environment.

Energy savings

Substantial heat energy is wasted daily in under-insulated facilities. Properly installed insulation immediately reduces energy needs — significant cost savings and improved productivity.

Process control

By reducing heat loss or gain, insulation helps maintain process temperatures within a predetermined range — critical in dynamic and static systems.

Condensation control

Sufficient insulation thickness with a vapor retarder prevents surface condensation on cold piping, ducts, and chillers — controlling mold, corrosion, and reduced service life.

Personnel protection

Thermal insulation protects workers from burns caused by contact with hot piping above 136°F — reducing surface temperatures to safe levels.

Fire protection

Insulation helps provide fire protection in firestop systems, grease and air-duct fireproofing, and electrical cable protection.

Sound attenuation

Insulation materials reduce noise exposure around mechanical equipment and piping systems in occupied buildings.

Aesthetics

Finished insulation surfaces can be painted or covered for a clean, professional appearance meeting inspection and occupant standards.

Greenhouse gas reduction

Thermal insulation provides immediate reductions in CO² and greenhouse gas emissions by reducing fuel consumption at combustion sites.
